items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: Hydration-safe prefers-reduced-motion hook.

items.name: springs
items.title: Spring math
items.description: Damped spring step, easing helpers and a seeded RNG.

items.name: rounded-outline
items.title: Rounded outline geometry
items.description: Arc-length parameterised rounded rectangle outline: points, normals, closest point.

items.name: pointer-field
items.title: Shared pointer tracker
items.description: One window pointer listener shared by every subscribing component.

items.name: magnetic-field
items.title: Magnetic field math
items.description: Displacement toward a pointer within a radius of a box. Pure, testable.

items.name: use-magnetic-field
items.title: useMagneticField
items.description: Sprung x/y/proximity motion values that follow a nearby pointer.

items.name: use-scroll-direction
items.title: useScrollDirection
items.description: Direction of the last meaningful scroll (up/down/idle) for the window or a container; re-renders only on change.

items.name: strand-field
items.title: StrandField simulation
items.description: Framework-free Verlet goo strand simulation around a rounded body.

items.name: bounded-value
items.title: Bounded value math
items.description: Domain validation, decimal-safe quantization, linear/log scales, detent hysteresis and strict number parsing for numeric inputs.

items.name: task-snapshots
items.title: Task snapshot authority
items.description: Pure reducer for host-reported tasks: newest attempt/revision wins, stale events rejected, terminal attempts frozen, deterministic primary selection.

items.name: compare-schema
items.title: Compare schema
items.description: Attribute normalisation and comparison: availability states, unit-aware equality with tolerance, schema-ordered rows and differences filtering.

items.name: palette-extract
items.title: Palette extraction
items.description: Deterministic colour extraction from RGBA pixels (alpha threshold, bucket quantisation, distance de-duplication, real sample points), colour parsing and sanitised CSS export.

items.name: transactions
items.title: Request/resolution helpers
items.description: Unique request ids and resolution matching for transactional components: only a resolution carrying the pending id settles it.

items.name: board-moves
items.title: Board move model
items.description: Immutable container/membership model: validation, id-addressed moves, no-op detection and inverse moves with conflict reporting.

items.name: patch-graph
items.title: Patch graph model
items.description: Typed port/connection validation with reasons, diagnostics for invalid edges, nearest-socket snapping and cable path geometry.

items.name: time-scale
items.title: Time scale
items.description: Epoch-ms time scale utilities: validation, deterministic sorting and lane allocation, window clamping/zoom, nice ticks, zone-aware formatting and strict ISO parsing.

items.name: chart-layout
items.title: Chart layout
items.description: Snapshot validation (units, ids, nulls), zero-inclusive shared domains, deterministic sorting and keyed row geometry for bar/dot charts.

items.name: graph-model
items.title: Graph model
items.description: Graph validation with diagnostics, adjacency and directed neighbourhoods, a deterministic bounded force layout and viewBox fitting.

items.name: seek-scheduler
items.title: Seek scheduler
items.description: Latest-target media seek scheduler with generation tokens, scroll-fraction mapping and chapter validation.

items.name: three-stage
items.title: Three.js stage
items.description: Demand-rendered Three.js stage: renderer, camera, lights, bounded orbit, pixel-ratio cap, context-loss handling and disposal.

items.name: exploded-parts
items.title: Exploded parts
items.description: Part path resolution, overlap validation, rest-transform snapshots and derived explode positions on Three.js trees.

items.name: clip-plane
items.title: Clip plane
items.description: Model-local bounds, normalised offsets, world clipping planes and cap-support rules for Three.js models.

items.name: finish-options
items.title: Finish options
items.description: Option group validation, compatibility rules with reasons, selection flags, allowlisted material params and generation ids.

items.name: strand-renderer
items.title: Strand renderer
items.description: Canvas 2D renderer for StrandField: ribbons, fillets, webs, highlights.

items.name: use-strand-field
items.title: useStrandField
items.description: Binds a StrandField to a canvas overlay with visibility gating and idle scheduling.

items.name: material-button
items.title: Material Button
items.description: A slab of goo that reaches for the pointer, grips it, and snaps back. Real <button>, reduced-motion and touch fallbacks.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: field-magnet
items.title: Field Magnet
items.description: A primitive that pulls its content toward a nearby pointer with springs. Children keep their semantics.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: liquid-switch
items.title: LiquidSnap Toggle
items.description: A switch whose thumb pours from one side to the other. Native role="switch", controlled/uncontrolled, form support, reduced-motion fallback.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: adaptive-rail
items.title: Contextual Floating Rail
items.description: A floating action rail (role=toolbar) that collapses to priority items while scrolling down, expands on scroll-up/idle/hover/focus, and scopes items to a context.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: ghost-trace-text
items.title: GhostTrace Headline
items.description: A headline traced by a ghost stroke before it settles into type. Semantic heading kept for AT; SVG is decorative; reduced-motion renders plain text.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: orbital-menu
items.title: Orbital Action Menu
items.description: Actions that orbit a trigger and settle into reach. Real menu semantics (aria-haspopup, role=menu, roving arrows, Escape), staggered spring launch, magnetic items.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: elastic-grid
items.title: ElasticCatalog
items.description: A catalog grid whose columns stretch toward the pointer and settle back, with layout animation for filtering and sorting. Plain list semantics.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: expanding-product-grid
items.title: ProductCard Expand
items.description: Product cards that expand in place into a detail view: full-row expansion with layout animation, one open at a time, aria-expanded title buttons and labelled detail regions.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: flow-stack-gallery
items.title: ThumbnailFlow Gallery
items.description: A gallery where thumbnails fly into a stacked viewer. Tabs/tabpanel semantics, deck shuffle with next/previous, arrow keys and drag, reduced-motion crossfade.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: mosaic-menu
items.title: MosaicRoute Menu
items.description: A full-screen route menu built from shifting mosaic tiles: modal dialog in a portal with focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus return; tiles assemble from the centre with staggered springs.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: activity-capsule
items.title: Activity Capsule
items.description: A morphing status capsule for host-reported tasks: attempt/revision authority, truthful progress, cancel/retry/dismiss as requests, expandable task list and restrained announcements.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: compare-workbench
items.title: Compare Workbench
items.description: Select two to four items into a tray and compare them in a semantic, schema-driven table with unit-aware equality, missing-data states, a differences filter and narrow-screen pair selection.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: elastic-range
items.title: Elastic Range
items.description: A bounded single or interval slider whose track bows past its ends. Preview while dragging, one commit per release; keyboard, step buttons and numeric entry as full alternatives.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: detent-dial
items.title: Detent Dial
items.description: A rotary numeric control with hysteretic detents, linear or log scale, vertical drag preview and single commits; arrows, fine steps, numeric entry and Reset without dragging.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: palette-composer
items.title: Palette Composer
items.description: Extract an editable six-slot palette from a local image: bounded decoding, local extraction, stale-result rejection, locked slots, validated edits and sanitised CSS export with clipboard fallback.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: decision-deck
items.title: Decision Deck
items.description: An undoable, transactional card stack: swipe, keys or buttons emit one decision request; pending until the host resolves; rejected requests restore the card; undo targets a decision id.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: transfer-board
items.title: Transfer Board
items.description: Move items between named containers with authority: a click-only Move menu, handle drag with placeholder preview and bounded autoscroll, id-addressed revisioned move requests, rejection restore and inverse-move undo.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: cable-patchbay
items.title: Cable Patchbay
items.description: Connect typed output ports to inputs with slack SVG cables: drag, two taps, keyboard or a text list produce one validated connection request; the host owns connections and settles each by id.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: time-lens
items.title: Time Lens
items.description: Overview band with a brushed window above a magnified detail lane: honest epoch-ms scale, lane-stacked events, zoom/ISO editor/list alternatives, explicit timezone display and preview-vs-commit windows.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: continuity-chart
items.title: Continuity Chart
items.description: Keyed bars that morph into dots and reorder across snapshots without losing identity; zero baseline, explicit nulls, unit diagnostics, authoritative table and values.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: focus-graph
items.title: Focus Graph
items.description: Searchable constellation with a semantic node list, neighbour details, a deterministic bounded force layout or authored positions, and click-only zoom/pan/fit/focus.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: scroll-film
items.title: Scroll Film
items.description: A scroll-synchronised film with an honest seek contract: clamped media-time range, one seek in flight, requested vs presented times, native playback that wins, transcript and chapters always available.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: exploded-product
items.title: Exploded Product
items.description: Move authored product parts apart along declared vectors on a demand-rendered Three.js stage; semantic parts list, progress derived from rest transforms, view presets and poster fallback.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: cutaway-viewer
items.title: Cutaway Viewer
items.description: Clip a prepared model with an axis-aligned plane across its model-local bounds; stencil caps only for declared-closed meshes, uncapped warnings otherwise, presets and no-drag controls.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: finish-configurator
items.title: Finish Configurator
items.description: Choose real product finishes on named parts: radio-group options with reasons, synchronous compatibility rules, per-instance material clones, generation-guarded textures and a declared default reset.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: flap-cells
items.title: Flap cells
items.description: Grapheme cells, change detection, staggered flip schedules compressed to a settle budget, numeric formatting and shaped-script detection.

items.name: split-flap-board
items.title: Split Flap Board
items.description: Mechanical split-flap cells for changing status values: one truthful accessible string, only changed cells flip, newest value wins, whole-content fallback for shaped scripts, reduced-motion instant swaps.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: point-targets
items.title: Point targets
items.description: Deterministic mask sampling, Morton ordering, resampling to a fixed count, curve offsets and allocation-free morph evaluation.

items.name: particle-morph
items.title: Particle Morph
items.description: A bounded, deterministically sampled point cloud that morphs between named image-mask or point targets with Three.js Points; latest request wins, fallback image and label stay truthful, reduced motion jumps.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: ascii-grid
items.title: ASCII grid
items.description: Aspect-preserving glyph grids, responsive columns, luminance sampling, ramp validation and glyph index mapping.

items.name: ascii-media
items.title: ASCII Media
items.description: Images and video rendered as a calibrated glyph grid on one canvas: native media stays the accessible timeline authority, bounded frame sampling, cross-origin/font/media fallbacks with reasons, native player under reduced motion.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: voice-pool
items.title: Voice pool
items.description: Note validation, a bounded polyphonic voice pool with oldest-first eviction and a mallet envelope.

items.name: glass-keybed
items.title: Glass Keybed
items.description: A finite labelled keybed with explicit audio consent: built-in Web Audio mallet voice, bounded polyphony, Stop all, borrowed-context safety, one activation per note and a visual-only fallback.
items.author: Creative UI

items.name: dock-layout
items.title: Dock layout
items.description: Versioned split/tab layout tree: validation, default layouts, pure moves, removal, ratio clamping, geometry and hit testing.

items.name: dock-workspace
items.title: Dock Workspace
items.description: Registered panels in split/tab groups with a versioned serializable layout: docking previews that propose one layout, menu and keyboard equivalents, minimum sizes, close permission, safe recovery and a compact single-panel mode.
items.author: Creative UI
